contentApproval.scope: Dataset v2, matrix v3, 90 individual human decisions, 15 induced targets and documented limitations; explicit authorization in project conversation.

relationships.caseToScenario: Dataset id equals matrix case ID; tags escenario:<ID> and ámbito:<domain>; exact 90-case correspondence.
relationships.adversarialTargets: targets equals adversarialMap.targets; 15 human-validated categories, each distinct from functional expectedCategory.
relationships.review: humanReview records every ID, reviewer, date, rule, text/category approval, rationale, realism, diversity, overlap and five resolutions.
relationships.versions: Dataset content 2 matches matrix content 3; matrix v2 and dataset v1 references in review are historical.
relationships.specification: Immutable reference to approved review/freezing/protocol/statistical requirements, not an executable runner manifest.

integrity.rule: Hash raw file bytes after final formatting; verify every artifact and manifest sidecar before use. Identity approval and execution authorization are separate and currently absent. Changes require revised identities and human review under I005 section 5.

auditHistory.scope: Only current-state declarations corrected; normative requirements, methodological decisions and all 90 matrix rows unchanged. Dataset, adversarial map and human review preserved byte for byte. Content versions retained.
auditHistory.auditFinding: Prior cryptographic audit passed; documentary current-state references to matrix v2 and pending content freeze were obsolete. These references now identify frozen dataset v2 and matrix v3; earlier states retained as history.
auditHistory.identityApproval: New identities require independent human approval; no inference or budget authorization.
